svg.aria-label: A failed Job is the alert: 1. Schedule: A CronJob fires every 30 minutes with Forbid concurrency and a 600 s deadline, so one stuck pod cannot block the next run. 2. Read: The script reads the Radarr v3, Sonarr v3 and Lidarr v1 queues, one page of up to 1000 records each, with keys from the secret. 3. Judge: An item added more than 24 hours ago is stale. A queue it cannot read counts as an error, never as a healthy zero. 4. Exit: Exit 0 means healthy, 1 means a stale item, 2 means a queue was unreadable. A failed Job feeds the existing KubeJobFailed alert.
